changelog.body:
1. Fix: module config not work
2. Remove ConfigProvider and database, which means those configs of previous version will be discarded. It's better to do a clear-data job after upgrading to this new version.

readme:
# Orange

Orange is a xposed module that support to specify orientation per app, which is useful for some app
that need specified orientation to get better experience (such as MAME4droid).

## Target Platform

| Platform | Min API |
|:---------|:-------:|
| Android  |   30    |  
| Xposed   |   93    |
